commitResults.messageTitle: Update README with project details and MVP features
commitResults.messageBody:
The README still reflects the original AddressBook template
and does not describe our DoctorWho project or its goals.

This makes the repository inconsistent with our actual
application and team details.

Replace template content with:
- Project name and team members (CS2103T-F10-1)
- Description of DoctorWho application
- MVP feature list (patient and appointment management)
- Project acknowledgement section

Retain the product website link placeholder for future
replacement.

These changes align the README with our current project
scope while properly crediting the original source.
Update README with project details and MVP features

No command exists to remove a patient's appointment from the system.

Doctors need a way to cancel or clear a scheduled appointment for
a patient without deleting the entire patient record.

Let's add the DeleteAppointmentCommand class with command word
deleteappt, which accepts a patient index as its only parameter.

Appointment-specific logic (empty appointment check and clearing the
appointment field) is stubbed with TODO comments as it depends on
the Appointment feature PR that has not yet been merged.

No parser exists to handle the deleteappt command input.

A parser is needed to extract and validate the patient index
from the raw CLI string before passing it to the command.

Let's add DeleteAppointmentCommandParser which parses a single
positive integer index using the existing ParserUtil.parseIndex().

Wiring into AddressBookParser is deferred to avoid a merge
conflict with the add appointment feature being developed in parallel.

commitResults.messageTitle: AddressBookParser: add routing for dapt command
commitResults.messageBody:
The dapt command class and parser exist but are not registered
in AddressBookParser.

Any input starting with dapt falls through to the default case
and throws an Unknown command error, making the feature unusable.

Let's add an import for DeleteAppointmentCommand and a switch case
that routes dapt to DeleteAppointmentCommandParser.

commitResults.messageTitle: AddressBookParser: add routing for dapt command
commitResults.messageBody:
The dapt command class and parser exist but are not registered
in AddressBookParser.

Any input starting with dapt falls through to the default case
and throws an Unknown command error, making the feature unusable.

Let's add an import for DeleteAppointmentCommand and a switch case
that routes dapt to DeleteAppointmentCommandParser.

commitResults.messageTitle: DeleteAppointmentCommand: update usage to patient terminology
commitResults.messageBody:
The usage text and Javadocs in DeleteAppointmentCommand still refer to
'person' and 'person list' from the original addressbook terminology.

The rest of the codebase has moved to patient terminology, so these
references are inconsistent and can confuse users and developers.

Let's update MESSAGE_USAGE and method Javadocs to use 'patient',
'patient list', and 'PATIENT_INDEX' consistently.

commitResults.messageTitle: DeleteAppointmentCommand: align dapt output with MVP spec
commitResults.messageBody:
The dapt command returns a patient-formatted success message and throws
an additional error when the target patient has no appointment.

The MVP specifies a success output in the form
'Appointment deleted for [NAME].' and lists invalid index as the
failure case for this command.

Let's update the success message format to use only the patient name and
remove the no-appointment failure branch so dapt behavior matches the
MVP command contract.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add parser tests for dapt input validation
commitResults.messageBody:
DeleteAppointmentCommandParser does not have tests covering invalid
forms of user input.

The dapt command accepts only a single positive patient index, so the
parser should reject malformed input consistently and return the usage
message.

Let's add parser tests covering valid input, empty input, non-numeric
input, zero, negative indices, and trailing non-whitespace arguments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add execution tests for dapt command behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
DeleteAppointmentCommand does not have tests covering its core runtime
behavior against the model.

The command should clear an existing appointment, reject out-of-bounds
indices, and behave consistently when the target patient already has no
appointment.

Let's add command tests covering successful deletion, invalid index
failure, and the idempotent no-appointment case.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add edge-case and object tests for dapt command
commitResults.messageBody:
DeleteAppointmentCommand tests cover the core execution behavior but do
not cover filtered-list index handling or command object semantics.

The command should fail when an index is out of bounds in the filtered
view, and its equals/toString methods should behave consistently to
support reliable assertions and debugging.

Let's add tests for invalid filtered-list index behavior, equals
contract checks, and toString output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add lsapt date parsing support and fix edit checkstyle naming
commitResults.messageBody:
ParserUtil currently does not support parsing an appointment date needed for the optional lsapt date filter.

Add the dt/ prefix and a strict parseAppointmentDate helper, and extend ParserUtilTest to cover valid input, invalid format, non-leap date rejection, null input, and whitespace trimming behavior.

EditCommand and EditCommandParser currently use descriptor variable names that violate checkstyle naming conventions.

Rename descriptor variables and parameters to lower camel case, and update EditCommandTest to match the updated toString output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extend model api for patient list comparator updates
commitResults.messageBody:
The model currently only exposes predicate-based filtering of the patient list.
To prepare for lsapt sorting, add a comparator update method to the model
contract so command logic can request sorting through the model layer.

Implement the new API in ModelManager with null-check validation and no
behavioural sorting change yet, since actual sorting behavior is planned for
the next commit.

Update tests and stubs to keep the codebase consistent with the new model
contract, including coverage for null comparator rejection and valid
comparator acceptance.

commitResults.messageTitle: Implement sorting support in model manager
commitResults.messageBody:
ModelManager currently exposes only filtered patient views and does not apply
sorting, which blocks lsapt from listing appointments in ordered form.

Return a SortedList-backed patient view from ModelManager, apply comparators
through updatePatientListComparator, and reset the comparator when the filtered
list predicate is updated so sorting remains command-scoped.

Add ModelManager tests covering comparator-driven ordering and reset-to-default
ordering after updateFilteredPatientList is called.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add parser for list appointment command
commitResults.messageBody:
List appointment input currently cannot be parsed, which blocks lsapt from supporting optional date filtering.

Add a dedicated parser for lsapt that accepts an optional dt/DATE argument, validates command format and duplicate prefixes, and parses appointment dates using the shared parser utility.

Add parser-focused tests covering no-argument success, valid date success, invalid date failure, non-empty preamble failure, and duplicate date-prefix failure.

commitResults.messageTitle: Implement list appointment command execution logic
commitResults.messageBody:
The lsapt command currently parses but does not execute listing behavior, so users cannot view appointments through command execution.

Implement ListAppointmentCommand to filter patients with appointments, apply optional date filtering when dt/DATE is provided, sort matched appointments by ascending appointment date-time, and return the required appointment count message.

Add command tests covering list-all behavior, date-filtered behavior, empty-result behavior, and object contract methods (equals and toString).

commitResults.messageTitle: Wire lsapt parser and fix post-lsapt list reset behaviour
commitResults.messageBody:
The lsapt command was implemented but not reachable from user input because AddressBookParser did not route the lsapt command word.

Add lsapt routing in AddressBookParser and parser integration tests for both no-date and date-filtered lsapt inputs to verify end-to-end parser entrypoint wiring.

Fix list state issues after lsapt where subsequent list, delete, and dapt operations could leave the UI in a stale filtered or sorted view.

Update ModelManager to clear comparator before updating predicates, and update DeleteCommand to reset the filtered list to show all patients after deletion.

Add regression tests covering list after lsapt, delete after lsapt, and dapt after lsapt to ensure the displayed list resets correctly and reflects updated patient and appointment states.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refine lsapt date validation messages and add invalid-date test coverage
commitResults.messageBody:
Date validation for lsapt currently reports only a generic format error, which makes calendar-invalid inputs like 29-02-2026 unclear to users.

Split date validation failures into two paths: malformed date format and invalid calendar date, and return distinct parse messages for each case.

Update parser tests to cover both malformed format input and invalid calendar date input for lsapt date parsing.

commitResults.messageTitle: Polish lsapt implementation and address review feedback
commitResults.messageBody:
The lsapt feature was functionally complete but still had review follow-ups on naming, consistency, parser test maintainability, and post-lsapt list-reset behavior.

Refine model and command integration by improving sorting-related naming, using clearer setter semantics for patient-list comparator updates, and aligning command code with existing static-import style for shared predicates.

Fix post-lsapt view reset issues so list, delete, and dapt interactions correctly restore or reflect the full patient list state after filtered/sorted appointment views.

Improve lsapt date validation feedback by distinguishing malformed date format from calendar-invalid dates, and add explicit parser coverage for invalid calendar date input.

Update tests for maintainability and consistency by replacing hardcoded appointment date prefixes with shared prefix constants and adding regression coverage for lsapt follow-up command behavior.
